remarks: Where comfort meets convenience. Welcome to 485 Summer Street a sundrenched 1 bedroom, 1 bath in the heart of downtown Stamford. Galley kitchen with granite countertops, tons of cabinets, dishwasher and gas oven range for cooking. Living room with skylight lets gorgeous natural light in. Great sized bedroom with HUGE walk-in closet with ample space. Nicely updated bathroom with subway tile and granite counter top off this elevated space. Central air. Free Laundry in the hallway. 1 parking space in secure parking garage. Elevator building. Small Fitness Center on first floor.
